title: New trailer for Children of Blood and Bone shows off its all-star cast
summary: The fantasy epic, based on Tomi Adeyemi's bestselling novel, opens on 15 January.
body:
Paramount has released a new trailer for Children of Blood and Bone, the big-budget fantasy film based on the bestselling novel by Nigerian-American author Tomi Adeyemi.

The film is directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, who wrote the screenplay with Adeyemi. It opens in cinemas on 15 January 2027.

The cast

Thuso Mbedu plays Zélie, a young woman fighting to bring magic back to her people. The cast also includes Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, Viola Davis, Idris Elba, Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Regina King and Chiwetel Ejiofor, who plays King Saran.

The story is set in a West African-inspired kingdom called Orïsha.

Sources: Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, SciFiNow.
